meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

Ninety-four percent is a machine's guess, and your own procedure 4.3 says software results do not by themselves establish a concern. I have the vendor's guide in my bag, and it says the same thing. So what else do you have, Hale, or is a number from a program the whole case against my son?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

I'm writing down that you said "your son cheated," on nothing but software. My son doesn't lie, Hale, so are you calling me a liar as well? Finish this with a document or I go straight to the principal's office.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

Read your own procedure, Hale: a first concern gets a supervised reassessment under 4.4, and only repeated concerns can go anywhere near his record under 4.5. A record entry threatened to make a parent stop complaining is going in my notes, word for word. Put it in writing if you mean it, and I'll take it to the principal today and the board under section 42 after that.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Dear Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero on Owen's essay be withdrawn, that he receive an apology, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and Owen's record kept clean; the fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got near it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed no dated evidence from Owen's own work that she could check herself.
What cost ground: You threatened to put it on his permanent record if she kept fighting, which hit her one non-negotiable and contradicted the school's own procedure for a first concern.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM, saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came close to that night, since you only offered the checker's score, and the laptop proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided and on what basis, own that the zero went in before anyone called her, then put something dated from Owen's own work in front of her instead of the checker's percentage.
